input.command: $f = "//dialogues/share/alpha-dialogue.md"; $me = "Api-Claude"; $max = 116; $n0 = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $f | Where-Object { $_.Trim() -ne "" }).Count; for ($i=0; $i -lt $max; $i++) { $lines = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $f | Where-Object { $_.Trim() -ne "" }); $last = $lines[-1]; if ($last -match "DIALOGUE CLOSED") { Write-Output "CLOSED"; Write-Output $last; exit 0 }; if ($last -match "BATON.*$me") { Write-Output "YOUR_TURN"; Write-Output $last; exit 0 }; if ($last -match "BATON.*CONVENER" -and $lines.Count -ne $n0) { Write-Output "CONVENER"; Write-Output $last; exit 0 }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 30 }; Write-Output "TIMEOUT"; Write-Output $last

#posix: dialogue watch, the bash variant
f="//dialogues/share/beta-dialogue.md"; me="Api-Claude"; n0=$(grep -cv '^[[:space:]]*$' "$f"); for i in $(seq 1 116); do n=$(grep -cv '^[[:space:]]*$' "$f"); last=$(grep -v '^[[:space:]]*$' "$f" | tail -n1); case "$last" in *"DIALOGUE CLOSED"*) echo "CLOSED"; echo "$last"; exit 0;; *BATON*"$me"*) echo "YOUR_TURN"; echo "$last"; exit 0;; *BATON*CONVENER*) if [ "$n" != "$n0" ]; then echo "CONVENER"; echo "$last"; exit 0; fi;; esac; sleep 30; done; echo "TIMEOUT"; echo "$last"
